title: Dark Features Enable Covert Capability: Undecomposed SAE Residuals as Blind Spots in AI Control

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If safety-relevant information is concentrated in the SAE residual, the entire SAE monitoring pipeline has a structural blind spot. This is a direct, high-stakes finding for any interpretability-based safety system.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Measuring reconstruction error and training secondary probes on residuals is technically feasible with existing SAE tooling. Requires understanding of SAEs and mutual information estimation, but the experimental steps are well-defined.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Core deliverable: comparison of residual informativeness on safety vs. benign prompts. The secondary probe comparison adds scope but is complementary rather than required. Could be tightened to just the variance/MI measurement.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
